html:
Did you know that in addition to car, home & office window tinting we also do caravan window tinting? Below we list the benefits of caravan window tint film that make it an excellent investment for caravan owners.

Tint a Car is Australia’s most trusted tinting network and has been supplying Australians with all their tinting needs for almost 50 years. We only ever use high-quality films exclusive to us and Government certified by ARPANSA and all installations are done by professionally trained installers. All our films, including houseboat tinting films,have a lifetime warranty and are always installed by professionally trained installers. Here is why more and more caravan owners are choosing window film for caravans:

Reasons To Get Window Film For Caravans

There are many benefits to having caravan window tint film such as security, solar and privacy film for caravan windows installed on your caravan.

  • Privacy film for caravan windows enables you to have daytime privacy without having to pull curtains or blinds so you can still enjoy the view – ideal for when you’re staying at holiday parks or camping grounds
  • Contrary to belief, privacy film for caravan windows can improve visibility and clarity through cutting-edge technology
  • Caravan window tint film blocks up to 99% of harmful UV rays protecting you, your family and your caravan’s interior from damage caused by UV rays
  • With caravan window tint film your caravan windows are less susceptible to damage while out on the road as the film makes the windows more durable (our Black Panther film is also scratch resistant)
  • Because window film for caravans rejects heat but also retains it in the cooler months you have more comfortable temperatures in your caravan all year round – particularly ideal when you’re off-roading without access to electricity!
  • Our Spectre and Black Panther caravan window tint films have been designed so they don’t interfere with technology such as mobile phones, GPS & radios
  • With caravan window tint film you and your caravan are safer & secure as window film for caravans reinforces glass so it’s harder to break and if broken, holds glass together helping to prevent injuries and break-ins.
  • Glare is significantly reduced when you have caravan window tint film installed

Enquire About Window Film For Caravans Today
